senses.gloss: (b. h.) a prefix = אֲשֶׁר, who, which, that, for &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>משעה שהכהנים וכ׳</he> from the time that the priests &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מעשה שבאו וכ׳</he> it happened that &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מה שאמרו וכ׳</he> in all cases in which the scholars fixed midnight as a term &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>עד שיעלה וכ׳</he> until the morning dawn rises. Ib. 2 <he>שכן דרך וכ׳</he> for such is the habit of kings &c. Ib. 4 <he>אינו רשאי שלא לחתום</he> he is not permitted to omit the closing benediction; <he>ושלא לחתום וכ׳</he> and where the scholars have arranged not to use a closing benediction &c.; a. v. fr.
